SMTPS::disable
       Disable SMTPS (STARTTLS for SMTP).

SYNOPSIS
       SMTPS::disable

DESCRIPTION
       Disable SMTPS (STARTTLS for SMTP)

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	    if { !([IP::addr [IP::client_addr] equals 10.0.0.0/8]) } {
		SMTPS::disable
	    }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.5.0
		   --First introduced the command.
